verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents one guided, natural-language-driven workflow ("Describe the task, review the plan and cost, approve the run, and get a trained model") for fine-tuning, but the rest of the platform (deployments, benchmarking, scaling, model uploads) is operated via API calls, CLI commands (firectl), and dashboards rather than natural-language commands. Missing for 10: broader NL-driven control across deployment/management features, evidence of a conversational agent/CLI for platform operations beyond the single fine-tuning flow, and independent corroboration of this guided-task feature actually working.
